<!-- What changes, and what a user notices. Link the issue if there is one. -->

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test` is green
- [ ] New behavior has a test, or a fixed bug has the test that would have caught it
- [ ] Docs updated if the change is visible to users (README, config schema, protocol notes)
- [ ] The commits and the PR title are conventional commits
- [ ] Anything bigger than a bug fix was agreed in an issue first
